title: Notification that an external plugin's blockchain watch matched
description: The **bwatch_match** notification is sent when the experimental `bwatch` plugin matches a watch whose owner begins with `plugin/`.
The owner is opaque to Core Lightning and allows subscribers to distinguish their own watches. Notifications are broadcast to every subscriber, so plugins must filter on owner.
Matches found during normal forward processing precede the corresponding `bwatch_block_processed` notification. Historical rescan matches instead complete when the add-watch RPC returns successfully.
The opaque `plugin/`-prefixed owner supplied when the watch was registered.
The kind of watch which matched.
The height of the block which satisfied the watch.
The matched raw transaction, for scriptpubkey and outpoint watches.
The transaction's index within the block.
The matched output index for a scriptpubkey or SCID watch, or input index for an outpoint watch.
The current confirmation depth for a blockdepth watch.
